releaseNotes.0.1.2.0:

releaseNotes.0.1.0.0:
Better Packing

Pack schematic components and Layout items with exposed control-pin spacing, a saved gap, and optional replacement of native Pack commands.

Requires the approved Designer 10.5 build and Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8 or later. Use the manager migration when replacing the legacy Schematic Tools bundle. Source and isolated-host validation are recorded in the repository README.
releaseNotes.0.2.0.0:
Better Packing 0.2.0

Requires Q-SYS Mods Core 0.1.6 or newer within 0.1.x, Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8+, and the exact supported Designer 10.5 build. Better Shortcuts is optional.

The four native Pack directions use Better Packing by default and retain one canonical action and their existing shortcuts. One Preferences checkbox restores all four native implementations without resetting user bindings. Legacy standalone assignments migrate to their native actions, preserving distinct alternatives and overwrite consent. Existing opt-outs survive migration. Center operations remain separate unbound actions; packing geometry is unchanged.

The new 0.2 package range enforces the updated Core dependency while retaining every historical 0.1.x package and approval. Windows CI now runs the existing 11 shared-router checks alongside the 18 geometry checks. Prior disposable Designer acceptance covers the four physical root-schematic shortcuts and native opt-out. Remaining menu, UCI and broader context acceptance stays in issue #2; this release does not claim new Designer or hardware coverage.
releaseNotes.0.2.1.0:
Better Packing 0.2.1

Choose Native or Better Packing separately for each element category in the Schematic and UCI editors, under File > Preferences > Better Packing. Defaults keep Better Packing for schematic components and Layout items, and native packing for schematic graphics/controls and every UCI category. A mixed selection uses native packing when any selected category is Native. Existing saved gaps, shortcuts and the master opt-out are retained.

Opted-in controls, headers, text, group boxes, images and polygons use the saved gap. Polygon packing accounts for vertex offsets from the model origin, including fractional offsets, without changing the vertices. All six native Pack commands now share the routing policy; former standalone center shortcuts migrate to their native equivalents. The explicit Better Packing window continues to apply enhanced packing independently of the routing choices. Groups, Flexboxes, unlisted types and component control panels retain native handling.

Requires Q-SYS Mods Core 0.1.6 or newer within 0.1.x, Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8+, and the exact supported Designer 10.5 build. Better Shortcuts is optional. The fast Alt + right-drag gap HUD remains future work.

Validation includes 25 portable contract checks and 23 Windows WPF routing/selection checks. Scoped native Designer evidence and remaining acceptance limits are recorded in docs/ELEMENT-PACKING.md and issue #2. This release makes no hardware or deployed-UCI claim.
releaseNotes.0.2.2.0:
Adds Pack to Top Pins and Pack to Bottom Pins using actual rendered pin centers, with a preference for main or exposed control pins. Preserves 0.2.1 per-editor packing choices, all six native commands and saved shortcuts. Pin actions are schematic-only and reject unavailable geometry before moving anything.
Native Designer checks cover nested Container/Channel Group pin alignment, main/exposed pins, grouped undo/redo, registered commands, and snap-target registration. Physical drag/key input and connected-wire coverage remain limited; no DSP/hardware claim.
releaseNotes.0.3.0.0: Adds separate Pack to Top Main Pins, Bottom Main Pins, Top Drawer Pins and Bottom Drawer Pins actions. Removes the global pin-group checkbox while preserving legacy shortcut IDs and full drawn spacing. The operation window now supports document Undo/Redo through Core 0.1.8. Requires Core >=0.1.8 and <0.2.0; historical package policies remain unchanged. All four buttons and focused-window Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y passed physical Designer checks; attached wires and save/reopen persistence passed. Fixture Input/Output labels remain test-only.
releaseNotes.0.3.1.0: Maintenance release. Rebuilt packages with updated release metadata. Existing functionality and compatibility are unchanged.

releaseNotes.0.1.0.0:
Adds attached-tip and home-component destinations to Designer's native Find by Context.

Seven commands provide separate next/previous probe and injector cycling, focused-tip navigation, home-component navigation and return home. Assign keys in Better Shortcuts; no default keys or existing assignments are changed.

Designer 10.5 Emulate checks verified native Find destinations and actual tip highlighting, physical shortcut cycling and wraparound, Find Home without detaching, and returning one focused tool while preserving the other attachment and gain/mute settings. Fixes cover unwired injector inputs and native tip highlight geometry.

Requires the exact supported Designer 10.5.0 build and Mods Core >=0.1.6 and <0.2.0. The package contains one private DLL. Release build: zero warnings/errors; 65 portable behavior checks and 73 host metadata checks passed. Live Core/hardware, nested/closed-page destinations, floating command dispatch, Command Palette execution and Undo remain outside this acceptance scope. See docs/VALIDATION.md.
releaseNotes.0.1.1.0:
Adds default shortcuts: Ctrl+F11 / Ctrl+Shift+F11 for next/previous Probe, Ctrl+F12 / Ctrl+Shift+F12 for next/previous Injector, and Ctrl+Alt+H to return the focused tool home.

Defaults use Mods Core's shared shortcut registry. Existing custom or cleared bindings take precedence, and conflicting defaults remain inactive without overwriting another action. Find Focused and Find Home remain unassigned. Better Shortcuts is optional for customization.

Requires the same exact Designer 10.5.0 build and Mods Core >=0.1.6 and <0.2.0. Navigation and return-home behavior are unchanged. See docs/VALIDATION.md for scoped application acceptance and remaining limits.

Requires Q-SYS Mods Core 0.1.6 or newer within 0.1.x, Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8+, and the exact supported Designer 10.5 build. The new package range enforces the dependency without changing historical 0.1.x packages or approvals.

Publishes the reviewed searchable command table, two-stroke recorder, explicit conflict overwrite, bulk default adoption, contextual adapters and effective native menu hints. Core remains the sole owner of shortcut registration, dispatch and persistence. Existing personal bindings and unrelated alternatives are preserved; recording and Preferences edits retain their shared save/cancel draft.

Recorded acceptance includes physical recorder/save, populated floating Component Controls, docked Monaco/Legacy editors, native property fields, native F5/F6/F7 and editing icon-menu hints/clicks. These results retain their original version and physical/automated attribution. Detached Actipro windows remain unsupported; additional commands, browser hosts and runtime UCI PopupTool acceptance remain in issue #2, with proposed new actions in issue #4. This packaging release adds no new Designer or hardware acceptance.

releaseNotes.0.1.0.0:
Clipboard Compatibility 0.1.0

Restores native component Copy All/Paste All using a bounded JSON clipboard transport on the exact inspected Designer 10.5.0 build. Requires Mods Core 0.1.5; Better Shortcuts is optional. Adds no shortcuts or preferences and preserves custom bindings.

Validated with 21 payload checks, 14 native transport/Harmony checks, and two Gains in disposable Designer Emulate using native commands and actual mouse input. Other component types and physical Core behavior remain untested.

This temporary compatibility mod is intended to be deprecated after QSC provides a verified native fix. Disable or remove it in Mod Manager with Designer closed, then restart and copy again. Historical package pins will be retained. Clipboard interoperability requires this mod in both participating Designer processes.

releaseNotes.0.1.5.0:
Q-SYS Mods Core 0.1.5

Core now owns native and mod command bindings, configurable two-stroke chords,
context guards, and effective shortcut labels without requiring Better Shortcuts.
Existing native keys and saved assignments take precedence over conflicting mod
defaults. Competing defaults remain unassigned, and intentional overwrite uses
the shared review/apply flow.

Includes grouped native-command replacements, retired-command alias migration,
and a live settings.json interface for supported Q-SYS General preferences and
mod settings. Changes are validated, conflicts remain visible, and last-good
recovery data is preserved. Unsupported or unknown settings are not silently
treated as writable native preferences.

The merged source passed automated contracts and the scoped Designer 10.5
acceptance documented in docs/SETTINGS-JSON.md and docs/MOD-CONTROLS.md. Physical
floating-window and recorder acceptance retains its documented limits.

Requires the exact supported Designer 10.5 binaries and Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8+.
Update old Better Packing/Better Shortcuts builds to 0.1.1 or newer when used
together. Existing mod preferences and user assignments are retained.
releaseNotes.0.1.6.0:
Q-SYS Mods Core 0.1.6

Publishes the reviewed shared command, chord and live-settings implementation together with the subsequent floating-window, editor-input and native icon-menu fixes. This is a new immutable package; it does not replace the earlier public 0.1.5 package or locally tested 0.1.5 pins.

Core owns commands, default shortcuts, deterministic collision handling, effective bindings and validated live settings.json. Better Shortcuts is an optional editor. Existing custom bindings, unknown mod settings, native Preferences and last-good recovery retain their established preservation behavior.

Use Core 0.1.6 with Better Packing 0.2.0 and Better Shortcuts 0.2.0. Both feature packages require Core >=0.1.6 and <0.2.0. Existing compatible Core 0.1.x consumers retain their dependency range. Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.8+ and the exact supported Designer 10.5 build remain required.

Recorded acceptance covers the physical recorder/save, populated floating Component Controls, docked Monaco/Legacy editors, native property fields, F5/F6/F7 preservation and native editing icon hints/clicks in the documented US-layout scope. Detached Actipro hosts remain unsupported; additional native commands and contexts remain tracked separately. Native component Paste All is a Q-SYS defect tracked as support case 00404915, with the separate Clipboard Compatibility mod providing the temporary remedy. This packaging release adds no new Designer or hardware acceptance.
releaseNotes.0.1.7.0: Adds File > Preferences > Mod Diagnostics with initialization state, module identity, errors and the diagnostics folder. Feature mods no longer need a status-only menu action. Ready indicates initialization only; it is not a hardware or feature acceptance result.
releaseNotes.0.1.8.0: Adds opt-in document Undo/Redo routing for modeless mod operation windows, following current shortcuts, remaps and chords while preserving text-local undo, native availability and cleanup. Deduplicates native history gestures before chord matching. Better Packing 0.3.0 adopts the API. Validation: 217 shared-control checks and physical Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y in the focused Packing window, with exact position restoration and attached wires preserved.

releaseNotes.0.1.10.0: Allows startup on an untested Designer build after accepting "WARNING: Untested on this version. Use at your own risk." in Q-SYS Mod Manager 0.10.0 or newer. Restart Designer after updating. This permits startup but does not establish compatibility; individual mods may have additional checks. The tested Designer 10.5 path is unchanged.
